meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 它会给项目加上 Matrix 聊天支持：从 channels 分支拷贝 Matrix 适配器、注册到频道入口、安装 @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix、修补 ESM 导入，再重新构建并跑注册测试。每一步都可以重复执行。
howto.when: 当你要让机器人接入 Matrix 聊天（房间或私聊）时执行；机器人账号与 Token 等凭据需要你自己在 Element 里注册并填写。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 Matrix 频道支持
say.note: 会拷贝适配器、装依赖并构建测试

say.text: 跑一下 matrix-registration 测试，看注册有没有漂移
say.note: 红色说明导入或依赖出了问题

say.text: 我的 Matrix 机器人收不到消息，帮我排查
say.note: 会检查 ESM 补丁与登录错误日志

howto.what_en: It adds Matrix chat support: copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix, patches ESM imports, then rebuilds and runs the registration test. All steps are safe to re-run.
howto.when_en: Run it when you want the bot to join Matrix rooms or DMs. The credential steps are manual — you register a separate bot account in Element and supply its settings.

say_en.text: Add Matrix channel support to this project
say_en.note: copies the adapter, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: Run the matrix-registration test to check the registry
say_en.note: red means the import or dependency drifted

say_en.text: My Matrix bot isn't receiving messages — help me debug
say_en.note: checks the ESM patch and login logs
